name: OSPYR·3 CLIENT DELIVERY BRAIN — 27 sub-automations: kickoff → tasks → SLAs → weekly client updates

parameters.content:
# 🚚 O3 · CLIENT DELIVERY BRAIN (27 sub-automations)
**KICKOFF (6):** ① `o-project-in` webhook (from O2 Won) → project row ② AI work-breakdown into tasks ③ owner assignment ④ due-dates auto-spread ⑤ kickoff checklist message ⑥ client welcome status.
**TASK ENGINE daily 08:45 (9):** ⑦ today's tasks per member ⑧ overdue flags ⑨ blocked-task escalation ⑩ deliverable-approval reminders ⑪ SLA breach alerts (>48h stuck) ⑫ workload imbalance warning ⑬ AI daily standup summary ⑭ done-yesterday recap ⑮ tomorrow preview.
**CLIENT COMMS (7):** ⑯ Friday client status drafts per project (AI, from Tasks) ⑰ deliverable-sent notifications ⑱ approval-request messages ⑲ scope-creep detector (tasks not in scope) ⑳ change-request logger ㉑ satisfaction pulse monthly ㉒ renewal-risk flag (low activity).
**HYGIENE (5):** ㉓ stale project alert ㉔ missing-asset chase ㉕ meeting→task via `#task client/desc/due` ㉖ weekly project scorecard ㉗ archive on completion.

**KEYS:** GEMINI_API_KEY · TG_OSPYR_CHAT · OSPYR_SHEET_ID (tabs: Projects[Client,Start,Scope,Status], Tasks[Client,Task,Owner,Due,Status]).
**FIX:** breakdown too generic → put a richer Scope when POSTing; SLA noisy → change 48h in engine.
